[Unit] Description=$ERPLibreDescription$ Requires=postgresql.service After=network.target network-online.target postgresql.service
[Service] Type=simple SyslogIdentifier=$ERPLibreUser$ PermissionsStartOnly=true User=$ERPLibreUser$ Group=$ERPLibreUser$ Restart=always RestartSec=5 PIDFile=$ERPLibreHome$/.venv.erplibre/service.pid ExecStart=$ERPLibreHome$/run.sh $ERPLibreExecParam$ WorkingDirectory=$ERPLibreHome$ StandardOutput=journal+console
[Install] WantedBy=multi-user.target
